        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_submit_merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_edit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_rules</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_firstinsp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_review_merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
